conclusions.finding: Generic confirmation switches its main action to type=button, so retained required date/custom interval fields cannot block normal confirm-button click or Enter activation of that button. Cancel and draft decision buttons also use type=button.

handleTaskSave prevents default and guards modalMode/session/prompt; reset restores submit type only for form mode; the next open recomputes required/disabled and clears date/interval error plus aria-invalid/describedby state.

Cancel retires the session, unlocks inert/disabled state, removes discard/saving status and clears confirmation handler. Save failure finally unlocks and restores focus; current-session checks protect subsequent dialogs.

Pointer focus suppression is released on pointerup/pointercancel/keydown/blur; deferred focus verifies the active target. Resize RAF repositions only menus still open, with no task-write or submit path.

boundary: Source review, not a repeated browser test of every confirmation sequence; existing original no-argument settings_flow 4/4 run belongs to root. 0847 to current source is proven to differ by only one removed redundant calendar aria-label line.
